ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity pixels (dark gray to black) dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface; high-intensity pixels (white to light gray) occupy approximately 15%, localized primarily at the distal tips and along the trailing edge serrations.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous blobs are mapped to the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. Fine-grained mottling of light-intensity pixels is scattered across the primarily dark medial and lateral fields. Subtle vertical light-intensity streaks are visible on the mid-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 64 degrees; the notch depth is roughly 18% of the total vertical span of the fluke lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex arc extending from the central peduncle attachment toward the tips, terminating in a sharp posterior hook at the lateral margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixel groups localized at the terminal edges of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single prominent, curved, high-intensity linear pixel disruption is located on the inner portion of the left lobe; multiple faint, vertical parallel linear disruptions are detectable on the upper-central region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct curved white scar is visible on the left lobe near the median notch; significant structural irregularities and high-contrast pixel clusters are present at both distal tips.
